blocks.zh: 參考文獻總覽解說
blocks.en: Overview of the references

blocks.zh: 本指引共引用 111 項參考文獻，涵蓋四大類別：
blocks.en: This guide cites 111 references in four main categories:

blocks.zh: 監管法規：ICH Q9/Q10、EU GMP、FDA CFR、EMA HBEL 指引
blocks.en: Regulations: ICH Q9/Q10, EU GMP, FDA CFR, EMA HBEL guideline

blocks.zh: ICH 協調指引：M7、Q3C、Q3D、Q7、Q8、Q11、Q12
blocks.en: ICH harmonised guidelines: M7, Q3C, Q3D, Q7, Q8, Q11, Q12

blocks.zh: 職業衛生與毒理學：OEL/ADE 建立方法、不確定係數文獻
blocks.en: Occupational health and toxicology: methods for establishing OELs/ADEs, literature on uncertainty factors

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證科學：MACO 計算、清潔化學、殘留分析
blocks.en: Cleaning validation science: MACO calculation, cleaning chemistry, residue analysis

blocks.zh: 核心監管與 ICH 參考文獻（1–32）
blocks.en: Core Regulatory and ICH References (1–32)

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解說 — 核心監管文件
blocks.en: Commentary — Core Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: 最重要文件：EMA HBEL 指引（參考文獻 #6）
blocks.en: The most important document: the EMA HBEL guideline (reference #6)

blocks.zh: EMA/CHMP/CVMP/SWP/169430/2012 是本指引最核心的監管參照。此指引確立了在共用設施中以 健康暴露限值（HBEL）取代傳統 1/1000 劑量標準的法規框架。2014年正式生效後，全球製藥廠須重新評估清潔驗證的接受限值基礎。
blocks.en: EMA/CHMP/CVMP/SWP/169430/2012 is the most important regulatory reference in this guide. It establishes the regulatory framework in which health-based exposure limits (HBELs) replace the traditional 1/1000 dose criterion in shared facilities. After it came into effect in 2014, manufacturers worldwide had to re-evaluate the basis of their cleaning validation acceptance limits.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 & Q10（#1 & #8）— 品質風險管理雙柱
blocks.en: ICH Q9 & Q10 (#1 & #8) — the two pillars of quality risk management

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（2005）建立了藥品品質風險管理的系統化框架，定義 FMEA、HAZOP、FTA 等工具的應用原則，是本 Vol.7 指引的理論基礎。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (2005) established a systematic framework for quality risk management of medicinal products and defines the principles for applying tools such as FMEA, HAZOP and FTA. It is the theoretical foundation of this Vol.7 guide.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（2008）確立藥品品質系統（PQS）概念，將 QRM 嵌入產品生命週期管理，與 Vol.7 的 CAPA 及風險回顧機制直接銜接。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (2008) established the concept of the pharmaceutical quality system (PQS) and embeds QRM in product lifecycle management; it links directly to the CAPA and risk review mechanisms of Vol.7.

blocks.zh: 第3章（廠房設備）與第5章（生產）2015年修訂版明確要求製造商採用 HBEL/ADE 作為交叉污染控制的科學依據，取代過去「可見殘留」標準。
blocks.en: The 2015 revisions of Chapter 3 (Premises and Equipment) and Chapter 5 (Production) explicitly require manufacturers to use HBEL/ADE as the scientific basis for cross-contamination control, replacing the earlier "visibly clean" criterion.

blocks.zh: 附件2（生物製品）與附件15（確效）定義了生物活性物質製造與清潔驗證的特殊要求。
blocks.en: Annex 2 (Biological Products) and Annex 15 (Qualification and Validation) define the special requirements for manufacturing biologically active substances and for cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211（#13）— FDA cGMP 核心法規
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 (#13) — the core FDA cGMP regulation

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 現行良好製造規範，涵蓋廠房設備、人員、製程管控、成品測試等完整要求。Vol.7 中所有風險管理措施均以符合此法規為前提。
blocks.en: The current good manufacturing practice regulations of the US FDA, covering the complete requirements for facilities and equipment, personnel, process control, finished product testing and so on. All risk management measures in Vol.7 presuppose compliance with this regulation.

blocks.zh: ICH M7（#7）— DNA 反應性雜質
blocks.en: ICH M7 (#7) — DNA reactive impurities

blocks.zh: 針對基因毒性雜質引入毒理學關注門檻（TTC）概念：1.5 μg/day 終生暴露為基準。在多產品共用設施中，若前一批次產品含基因毒性雜質，清潔驗證限值需特別嚴格。
blocks.en: Introduces the threshold of toxicological concern (TTC) concept for genotoxic impurities, with a lifetime exposure of 1.5 µg/day as the reference. In a multi-product shared facility, if the preceding product contains genotoxic impurities, the cleaning validation limit must be especially strict.

blocks.zh: 2011年指引引入持續製程驗證（CPV）概念，強調以統計製程控制（SPC）取代傳統一次性驗證。Vol.7 的 CPP 監控體系與此指引直接呼應。
blocks.en: The 2011 guidance introduced the concept of continued process verification (CPV), which emphasizes statistical process control (SPC) in place of traditional one-time validation. The CPP monitoring system in Vol.7 echoes this guidance directly.

blocks.zh: 科學文獻與技術標準（33–111）
blocks.en: Scientific Literature and Technical Standards (33–111)

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解說 — 科學文獻與標準
blocks.en: Commentary — Scientific Literature and Standards

blocks.zh: ADE/OEL 建立方法學核心文獻
blocks.en: Core literature on ADE/OEL methodology

blocks.zh: 參考文獻 #36–#64 構成 ADE 與 OEL 建立的毒理學方法論基礎。以下為關鍵作者與貢獻：
blocks.en: References #36–#64 form the toxicological methodology basis for establishing ADEs and OELs. The key authors and their contributions are:

blocks.zh: Naumann & Weideman（#39）：製藥 API 的不確定係數科學基礎，奠定 PDE/ADE 計算框架
blocks.en: Naumann & Weideman (#39): the scientific basis of uncertainty factors for pharmaceutical APIs, which laid the PDE/ADE calculation framework

blocks.zh: Sargent et al.（#42）：ADE 建立實務指引，直接影響 EMA HBEL 指引
blocks.en: Sargent et al. (#42): practical guidance on establishing ADEs, which directly influenced the EMA HBEL guideline

blocks.zh: Sussman et al.（#34, #44）：高危害藥物識別與 ADE 調整係數諧調
blocks.en: Sussman et al. (#34, #44): identification of highly hazardous drugs and harmonisation of ADE adjustment factors

blocks.zh: Lehman & Fitzugh（#61）：1954年「100倍安全係數」原典，現代毒理學安全評估的歷史起點
blocks.en: Lehman & Fitzhugh (#61): the original 1954 source of the "100-fold safety factor", the historical starting point of modern toxicological safety assessment

blocks.zh: 毒理學關注門檻（TTC）文獻群組（#43, #69–#78）
blocks.en: Threshold of toxicological concern (TTC) literature group (#43, #69–#78)

blocks.zh: TTC 概念源自 FDA 1995年 21 CFR 170.39，後經 Munro、Kroes 等系列論文發展為結構-活性關係基礎的閾值體系。應用於製藥製造的關鍵論文為 Dolan et al.（2005，#69），將 TTC 延伸至短期臨床試驗的交叉污染評估。
blocks.en: The TTC concept originates from FDA 21 CFR 170.39 (1995) and was later developed by a series of papers by Munro, Kroes and others into a threshold system based on structure-activity relationships. The key paper for pharmaceutical manufacturing is Dolan et al. (2005, #69), which extended TTC to the assessment of cross-contamination in short-term clinical trials.

blocks.zh: Fourman & Mullen（#84）— 清潔驗證限值的原典
blocks.en: Fourman & Mullen (#84) — the original source of cleaning validation limits

blocks.zh: 1993年 Pharmaceut. Technol. 論文首次系統化提出 MACO 計算公式：
blocks.en: The 1993 paper in Pharmaceut. Technol. was the first to present the MACO calculation formula systematically:

blocks.zh: 此公式後被修改為以 ADE/PDE 為基礎的現代版本，但原理相同。
blocks.en: This formula was later modified into the modern ADE/PDE-based version, but the principle is the same.

blocks.zh: HVAC 與空氣過濾標準（#104–#111）
blocks.en: HVAC and air filtration standards (#104–#111)

blocks.zh: Vol.7 的空氣傳播交叉污染控制需符合多項標準：
blocks.en: Control of airborne cross-contamination in Vol.7 must comply with several standards:

blocks.zh: ASHRAE 52.2：MERV 額定值測試方法
blocks.en: ASHRAE 52.2: test method for MERV ratings

blocks.zh: BS EN 1822：HEPA/ULPA 過濾器分類（EPA、HEPA、ULPA 等級）
blocks.en: BS EN 1822: classification of HEPA/ULPA filters (EPA, HEPA and ULPA grades)

blocks.zh: IEC 60812：FMEA 分析技術標準
blocks.en: IEC 60812: technical standard for FMEA analysis

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證科學文獻（Sharnez 系列，#88–#103）
blocks.en: Cleaning validation literature (Sharnez series, #88–#103)

blocks.zh: Sharnez 博士的系列論文涵蓋清潔製程的 QbD 方法、小規模模型建立、清潔動力學參數（流速、土壤負荷、濕度），為 Vol.7 附錄一中清潔驗證計算提供科學支撐。
blocks.en: Dr. Sharnez's series of papers covers the QbD approach to cleaning processes, the development of small-scale models and cleaning kinetics parameters (flow rate, soil load, humidity), providing scientific support for the cleaning validation calculations in Appendix 1 of Vol.7.

blocks.zh: p167–p170 | 完整縮寫對照表，含重點術語中文說明
blocks.en: p167–p170 | Complete acronym table, with commentary on key terms

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解說 — 重點縮寫詳解
blocks.en: Commentary — Key Acronyms Explained

blocks.zh: HBEL — Health-Based Exposure Limit｜健康暴露限值
blocks.en: HBEL — Health-Based Exposure Limit

blocks.zh: 雖然 HBEL 本身未列入縮寫表，但為本指引最核心概念。HBEL 是以 ADE（Acceptable Daily Exposure）或 PDE（Permitted Daily Exposure）為基礎計算出的暴露限值，用於共用設施交叉污染風險評估，取代傳統 1/1000 最小治療劑量或 10 ppm 可見殘留標準。
blocks.en: Although HBEL itself is not in the acronym table, it is the most central concept of this guide. An HBEL is an exposure limit calculated on the basis of the ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure) or PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure), used for cross-contamination risk assessment in shared facilities. It replaces the traditional 1/1000 minimum therapeutic dose or 10 ppm visible-residue criteria.

blocks.zh: ADE vs PDE — 兩個核心暴露限值
blocks.en: ADE vs PDE — the two core exposure limits

blocks.zh: ADE（可接受每日暴露量）：由 ISPE 風險管理社群推廣，適用於多路徑暴露評估（包括口服、吸入、皮膚）。終生暴露不產生不良效應的劑量。
blocks.en: ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure): promoted by the ISPE risk management community and applicable to multi-route exposure assessment (including oral, inhalation and dermal). It is the dose at which lifetime exposure produces no adverse effects.

blocks.zh: PDE（允許每日暴露量）：EMA HBEL 指引與 ICH Q3C 採用的術語。計算邏輯與 ADE 相同，但命名來自監管文件。
blocks.en: PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure): the term used in the EMA HBEL guideline and ICH Q3C. The calculation logic is the same as for the ADE; only the name comes from the regulatory documents.

blocks.zh: 實務上：ADE ≈ PDE，兩者常互換使用，計算公式相同。
blocks.en: In practice: ADE ≈ PDE. The two are often used interchangeably and the calculation formula is the same.

blocks.zh: MACO — Maximum Allowable Carryover｜最大允許殘留轉移量
blocks.en: MACO — Maximum Allowable Carryover

blocks.zh: MACO 未列入本縮寫表，但為清潔驗證最重要計算結果。公式：
blocks.en: MACO is not in this acronym table, but it is the most important calculated result in cleaning validation. The formula:

blocks.zh: 此結果轉換為表面殘留限值（μg/cm²），指導清潔驗證取樣標準。
blocks.en: This result is converted into a surface residue limit (µg/cm²), which guides the sampling criteria for cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: NOAEL / NOEL / LOAEL — 毒理學劑量描述符
blocks.en: NOAEL / NOEL / LOAEL — toxicological dose descriptors

blocks.zh: NOAEL（無可觀察不良效應劑量）：動物實驗中未觀察到不良效應的最高劑量，是 ADE 計算的主要起始點（Point of Departure, PoD）
blocks.en: NOAEL (No Observed Adverse Effect Level): the highest dose at which no adverse effect is observed in animal studies; the main point of departure (PoD) for ADE calculation

blocks.zh: NOEL（無可觀察效應劑量）：比 NOAEL 更嚴格，連適應性效應都未出現
blocks.en: NOEL (No Observed Effect Level): stricter than the NOAEL, since not even adaptive effects appear

blocks.zh: LOAEL（最低可觀察不良效應劑量）：當 NOAEL 不可得時作為替代 PoD，通常需額外增加不確定係數（UF = 3–10）
blocks.en: LOAEL (Lowest Observed Adverse Effect Level): used as an alternative PoD when no NOAEL is available; an additional uncertainty factor (UF = 3–10) is usually needed

blocks.zh: RPN — Risk Priority Number｜風險優先數
blocks.en: RPN — Risk Priority Number

blocks.zh: FMEA 中核心量化指標：RPN = 嚴重性（S）× 發生頻率（O）× 可偵測性（D），各項 1–10 分，RPN 範圍 1–1000。Vol.7 附錄1案例中：RPN < 125 可接受；125–343 需降低風險；> 343 不可接受，須停止作業。
blocks.en: The core quantitative metric in FMEA: RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detectability (D), each scored 1–10, so the RPN ranges from 1 to 1000. In the Vol.7 Appendix 1 case studies: RPN < 125 is acceptable; 125–343 requires risk reduction; > 343 is unacceptable and operations must stop.

blocks.zh: CPP / CQA / CPV — 製程生命週期三角
blocks.en: CPP / CQA / CPV — the process lifecycle triangle

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）：必須被監控和控制的製程變數
blocks.en: CPP (critical process parameter): a process variable that must be monitored and controlled

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）：必須符合規格的產品特性
blocks.en: CQA (critical quality attribute): a product characteristic that must meet its specification

blocks.zh: CPV（持續製程驗證）：商業化生產期間的持續監控，對應 FDA 2011年製程驗證指引
blocks.en: CPV (continued process verification): ongoing monitoring during commercial production, corresponding to the FDA 2011 process validation guidance

blocks.zh: FMEA / HAZOP / FTA — QRM 工具三劍客
blocks.en: FMEA / HAZOP / FTA — the three main QRM tools

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式與效應分析）：前瞻性，適合設備/製程設計審查，計算 RPN
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): prospective, suited to equipment/process design review, and calculates the RPN

blocks.zh: HAZOP（危害與可操作性分析）：關鍵字驅動（More/Less/No/As Well As），適合連續製程和管道系統
blocks.en: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study): driven by guide words (More/Less/No/As Well As), suited to continuous processes and piping systems

blocks.zh: FTA（故障樹分析）：後推性分析，從頂事件（不良結果）向下找根本原因
blocks.en: FTA (Fault Tree Analysis): a backward-looking analysis that works downward from the top event (the adverse outcome) to find root causes

blocks.zh: OEB — Occupational Exposure Band｜職業暴露分級帶
blocks.en: OEB — Occupational Exposure Band

blocks.zh: OEB 是在尚未建立完整 OEL 時，依據毒性資料初步分類化合物危害等級的工具：
blocks.en: An OEB is a tool for the preliminary hazard classification of a compound from toxicity data when a full OEL has not yet been established:

blocks.zh: p170–p176 | 45項定義，涵蓋 ADE、OEB、PDE、MACO、ALARP 等核心術語
blocks.en: p170–p176 | 45 definitions covering core terms such as ADE, OEB, PDE, MACO and ALARP

blocks.zh: 繁體中文解說 — 核心定義中文對照與詮釋
blocks.en: Commentary — Core Definitions Explained

blocks.zh: ADE（可接受每日暴露量） — 最重要定義
blocks.en: ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure) — the most important definition

blocks.zh: 核心意涵：ADE 是終生暴露的安全劑量，保護所有次族群（老人、兒童、孕婦、病患），適用所有暴露途徑。
blocks.en: Core meaning: the ADE is the safe dose for lifetime exposure; it protects all subpopulations (the elderly, children, pregnant women, patients) and applies to all routes of exposure.

blocks.zh: 計算公式：
blocks.en: Calculation formula:

blocks.zh: ADE = (NOAEL × 體重調整 × 暴露頻率調整) / (不確定係數 UF1×UF2×...×UFn)
blocks.en: ADE = (NOAEL × body weight adjustment × exposure frequency adjustment) / (uncertainty factors UF1×UF2×...×UFn)

blocks.zh: 實務應用：ADE 值決定清潔驗證 MACO 限值，也是 OEB 分級的依據。製藥廠在引入新 API 時，毒理學家必須先建立 ADE。
blocks.en: Practical application: the ADE value determines the cleaning validation MACO limit and is also the basis for OEB classification. When a pharmaceutical company introduces a new API, a toxicologist must first establish the ADE.

blocks.zh: PDE（允許每日暴露量） — 與 ADE 的關係
blocks.en: PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure) — relationship to the ADE

blocks.zh: PDE 源自 ICH Q3C（殘留溶劑指引），後被 EMA HBEL 指引採用為共用設施交叉污染控制的標準術語。計算邏輯與 ADE 完全相同，差別僅在命名慣例：
blocks.en: The PDE originates from ICH Q3C (the residual solvents guideline) and was later adopted by the EMA HBEL guideline as the standard term for cross-contamination control in shared facilities. The calculation logic is exactly the same as for the ADE; the only difference is the naming convention:

blocks.zh: ISPE / RiskMAPP 社群 → 使用 ADE
blocks.en: ISPE / RiskMAPP community → uses ADE

blocks.zh: EMA HBEL 指引、ICH Q3C → 使用 PDE
blocks.en: EMA HBEL guideline, ICH Q3C → uses PDE

blocks.zh: 實務上：ADE = PDE
blocks.en: In practice: ADE = PDE

blocks.zh: OEB（職業暴露分級帶） — 早期控制策略工具
blocks.en: OEB (Occupational Exposure Band) — an early control strategy tool

blocks.zh: 在尚未取得完整毒理數據時，OEB 依據已知藥理/毒理特性將化合物初步分為 5 個等級（OEB 1 最低危害 → OEB 5 最高危害），並與對應的工程控制策略掛鉤：
blocks.en: When full toxicological data are not yet available, the OEB uses known pharmacological/toxicological properties to place a compound into one of 5 bands (OEB 1 lowest hazard → OEB 5 highest hazard), each linked to a corresponding engineering control strategy:

blocks.zh: OEB 1–2：開放製程，一般通風即可
blocks.en: OEB 1–2: open processing, general ventilation is sufficient

blocks.zh: OEB 3：局部排氣通風（LEV）
blocks.en: OEB 3: local exhaust ventilation (LEV)

blocks.zh: OEB 4：完全封閉設備、隔離手套箱
blocks.en: OEB 4: fully enclosed equipment, isolator glove boxes

blocks.zh: OEB 5：專用設施、嚴格隔離、負壓環境
blocks.en: OEB 5: dedicated facility, strict containment, negative pressure environment

blocks.zh: MACO（最大允許殘留轉移量） — 清潔驗證核心
blocks.en: MACO (Maximum Allowable Carryover) — the core of cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 雖然 MACO 未出現於定義表中，但是本指引清潔驗證的核心計算值。MACO 計算需要 ADE/PDE 值，並考慮後續批次的最大批量與最大每日劑量。
blocks.en: Although MACO does not appear in the definitions table, it is the core calculated value for cleaning validation in this guide. The MACO calculation needs the ADE/PDE value and takes into account the maximum batch size and maximum daily dose of the subsequent product.

blocks.zh: MACO → 換算為表面殘留限值 → 對比清潔驗證拭抹樣品結果 → 決定清潔是否合格。
blocks.en: MACO → converted to a surface residue limit → compared with cleaning validation swab results → determines whether cleaning is acceptable.

blocks.zh: ALARP（盡可能低） — 風險管理原則
blocks.en: ALARP (As Low As Reasonably Practicable) — a risk management principle

blocks.zh: ALARP（As Low As Reasonably Practicable）雖未列入本縮寫表，但為 Vol.7 風險控制決策的指導原則。其意涵：在技術可行且經濟合理的前提下，將風險降至盡可能低的水準。不等於「零風險」，而是在風險與成本間取得合理平衡。
blocks.en: Although ALARP is not in this acronym table, it is the guiding principle for risk control decisions in Vol.7. It means reducing risk to as low a level as possible, provided this is technically feasible and economically reasonable. It does not mean "zero risk"; it means striking a reasonable balance between risk and cost.

blocks.zh: PoD（起始點）— ADE 計算的出發點
blocks.en: PoD (Point of Departure) — the starting point of ADE calculation

blocks.zh: PoD 是毒理學家進行 ADE 推算的關鍵起點：
blocks.en: The PoD is the key starting point from which a toxicologist derives the ADE:

blocks.zh: 優先選用 NOAEL（動物或人體研究）
blocks.en: Preferably use the NOAEL (from animal or human studies)

blocks.zh: 若無 NOAEL，使用 LOAEL + 額外 UF（3–10×）
blocks.en: If there is no NOAEL, use the LOAEL + an additional UF (3–10×)

blocks.zh: 現代方法：BMD（基準劑量）建模取代 NOAEL，提供更精確的統計 PoD
blocks.en: Modern approach: BMD (benchmark dose) modelling replaces the NOAEL and provides a more precise statistical PoD

blocks.zh: PoD 選擇直接影響 ADE 大小，是整個 HBEL 評估中最需要毒理學專業判斷的步驟。
blocks.en: The choice of PoD directly affects the size of the ADE and is the step in the whole HBEL assessment that most requires toxicological expert judgment.

blocks.zh: Retention vs Carry Over — 兩個容易混淆的定義
blocks.en: Retention vs Carry Over — two easily confused definitions

blocks.zh: Retention（殘留）：產品接觸面上的殘留量，是靜態概念，指清潔後仍附著在設備表面的物質。
blocks.en: Retention: the amount of residue on a product-contact surface. It is a static concept, referring to material still adhering to the equipment surface after cleaning.

blocks.zh: Carry Over（帶入）：Retention 的動態結果，指殘留物在下一批次生產時被帶入產品的量。Carry Over = Retention × 接觸因子。
blocks.en: Carry Over: the dynamic result of retention, referring to the amount of residue that is carried into the product during the next batch. Carry Over = Retention × contact factor.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的目標是確保 Carry Over ≤ MACO。
blocks.en: The goal of cleaning validation is to ensure that Carry Over ≤ MACO.

blocks.zh: Highly Hazardous Drugs — 高危害藥物三大類別
blocks.en: Highly Hazardous Drugs — three categories

blocks.zh: 本定義涵蓋三類高危害化合物，需要最嚴格的 OEB 5 控制措施：
blocks.en: This definition covers three classes of highly hazardous compounds that require the strictest OEB 5 control measures:

blocks.zh: 基因毒性致癌物：已知或高可能性對人類致癌（如鉑類化合物）
blocks.en: Genotoxic carcinogens: known or highly likely human carcinogens (such as platinum compounds)

blocks.zh: 生殖/發育毒性物質：低劑量即可產生生殖或發育毒性（如沙利竇邁類）
blocks.en: Reproductive/developmental toxicants: substances that cause reproductive or developmental toxicity at low doses (such as thalidomide-type compounds)

blocks.zh: 嚴重靶器官毒性物質：低劑量產生嚴重不良效應（如細胞毒性抗癌藥）
blocks.en: Substances with severe target organ toxicity: substances that cause severe adverse effects at low doses (such as cytotoxic anticancer drugs)

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management (QRM) — Vol.7 的核心框架
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM) — the core framework of Vol.7

blocks.zh: QRM 的四步驟循環：
blocks.en: The four-step QRM cycle:

blocks.zh: 評估（Assessment）：識別危害、分析暴露途徑、評估風險大小
blocks.en: Assessment: identify hazards, analyze exposure routes, evaluate the magnitude of risk

blocks.zh: 控制（Control）：工程控制（隔離、HVAC）、管理控制（SOP、CAPA）
blocks.en: Control: engineering controls (isolation, HVAC) and administrative controls (SOPs, CAPA)

blocks.zh: 溝通（Communication）：向管理層和監管機構報告風險狀態
blocks.en: Communication: report the risk status to management and regulators

blocks.zh: 回顧（Review）：定期審查（至少每年一次），產品組合或製程變更時立即觸發
blocks.en: Review: periodic review (at least once a year), triggered immediately by changes in the product portfolio or process

blocks.zh: Wipe Limit — 表面殘留監控的謹慎解讀
blocks.en: Wipe Limit — interpreting surface residue monitoring with caution

blocks.zh: 指引特別提醒：拭抹結果應在交叉污染風險評估的脈絡下謹慎解讀，不可脫離 ADE 值單獨使用。拭抹效率（回收率）因物質、表面材質、拭抹技術而異，實際表面殘留量可能被低估或高估 2–10 倍，需納入不確定性評估。
blocks.en: The guide specifically cautions that swab results should be interpreted carefully in the context of the cross-contamination risk assessment and must not be used in isolation from the ADE value. Swab efficiency (recovery) varies with the substance, surface material and swabbing technique, so the actual surface residue may be under- or overestimated by a factor of 2–10, and this uncertainty must be taken into account.
